'''Alger Sodoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] working for the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He utilized a [[Z-TIE]] to defend [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base|Dobah's hideout]].
